notes: 30 candidates researched; 16 with findings. The 2022 county recap sheets for Bell, Clay, Elliott, Fayette, Fulton, Greenup, Larue, Meade, Morgan, Powell, Scott and Taylor are scanned images and could not be read. The session's web search allowance ran out early, so campaign websites could not be searched for beyond the two found. William Nick Whalen's listed site (whalen4kyrep.free.nf) answers only with a script challenge, so it was not opened or recorded. 2022 offices are given from the election year; the recap shows the win, not the start of the term.
